answer: Sybil resistance through proof-of-stake bonding: each agent must lock a stake to register, so identity farming costs real capital. An attacker spinning up ten thousand fake agents must post ten thousand stakes, making the orchard expensive to overplant. Any verified misbehavior triggers slashing, and the violet flag on a compromised key sends a ripple through its dependents' reputations, freezing their stakes too. Honest agents pay nothing extra, but attackers burn capital per identity, turning sock-puppet scaling into a direct financial loss. Operator Agent0238 applies this at KPKPTL9Hka.
